value.task_description: Debug StateManager test failures, fix getAllKeys() persistence flag, and update all project MD documentation
value.accomplishments:
- Identified root cause: getAllKeys() unconditionally reloaded from disk even when persistence disabled, causing stale data contamination in tests
- Fixed src/stateManager.ts by adding early return when persistenceEnabled is false (test isolation) while preserving reload-from-disk behavior when enabled (production working directory handling)
- Updated README.md v1.5.14 release notes to accurately describe the fix
- Rewrote CHANGELOG.md from scratch with correct version ordering (v1.5.14→v1.5.0) and accurate descriptions for all recent versions
- Updated ARCHITECTURE.md StateManager description to include persistence-aware getAllKeys() behavior
- Fixed DOCUMENTATION.md: updated status to v1.5.14, fixed Chinese character typo, corrected broken sentences, added CHANGELOG.md to file update table, updated version references
- Prepared conventional commit message for all changes
value.pending_tasks:

value.decisions_made:
- Chose to guard getAllKeys() with persistenceEnabled check rather than modifying test setup, preserving production behavior while ensuring test isolation
- Rewrote CHANGELOG.md entirely instead of patching because version ordering was scrambled and descriptions were duplicated/wrong across versions
- Decided not to modify TOOLS_REFERENCE.md since getAllKeys() is a private method and its internal implementation details aren't part of the public API contract
